tinowelihskino ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsil'anelhohi unathvkane'i ale uniyole iyunvnhehtiyi unihihstiyi kvwanyehskeyhenho nvtikalhstohtihske nikatv yvwi unihskwanikohskv nuhstv tateyhohvhskv'i

iyuhskini nitsatanhehvna ikehsehsti etsihskanvtsel'i vlha nahskwo itsitota kalvlati ehi yvketsitoliki itsihskanvtsv'i
tsiluhsilimhinho thaline uniluhtse'i utvnvnho'tikalawi'ihstiyi etohe'i kvwaluhtsele nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale tinowelihski ale tinilawiki

iyunho yvwikwo anehv yikatvnnhahski tanihska'ihe yvwi nikatyhenho yvwi atolehohski utohiyuhi kvwayelvha tsani

unvnhihstiyinho kehsv iyu'i unvhse unvhsitahsti tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi tinehv'i nahski tlokehsi tsunilvwhihstanehi nvtakvwanehtiyi unehkwotsvhi thelvlati tawhihsv'i

thalinenho nvwatale unvhse'i ale nahski unilhe'i ale unitsathe nvwanatale'i ikatv tanili'vnhihe'i ikatvnho tanihihe'i

tsuniyohuhsvhin nhski tsunalehihsohti kehsv'i lhsko yitsikoliye'o mohsi utseli kowhelihi nahski uweyhohta'tv unelhanvhi ulhinhehthanv'i hi'a nuwehsel'i ayv akwanelhanvhi ekwahami utselika ale akwanelanvhi ehsiki utselika ale akwanelanvhi tsekakwi utselika
tinowelihskinho kehsv ahsiyvwi uluhtselv uthvkanv analhinohehskv'i ale utolehohsv ohsiyu nuwehsv tunhetselv'i utvtvnhe'i kato uhsti uli kalvkwtiyu nikatv tikhanhawatvhsti kehsv'i' utvnhe'i
tsihsa unhetsele hi'a nuwehsel'i utli kalvkwti nikatv tikhanhawatvhsti kehsv hi'a nahski hathvkvka ihsili yihowa ikanelanvhi hsakwohiyu yihowa

tsihsanho unhetsv tateyohvhskv uthvnvtikalawi'ihstiyi hi'a nuwehse'i katonho tinowhelihski kalonetv tewi uwetsi tsanatihsko'i'
tewiyhenho uwahsv ukvwiyuhi ikohseha katonho tikalhstohtiha uwetsi iki' unitsathinho yvwi unalihelitsvhi kvwathvtanele'i
ale nukvwiyuhsv tekahskilv tikalawi'ihstiyi ale nukvwiyuhsv tsunanhitlvtiyi tanalhstayvhvkv'i

khilono iyuhsti uyo iyutvnhateki uwohsulotsvhi uluhtsv tha'li akinuthvhti iyatanhvhthehti unhe'i nahski ayelhi iyatanhvhthehti ika'i tsiki
wituyhanvhvnho kvwhstawtitohi hi'a nituwehsele'i utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha hi'a nahski uyo iyutvnhateki uwohsulotsvhi utli ika'i ahvka ehskakwo nikathv nhski atelvtihtiyi tsanihvka
nikatvyhenho utsathi unihv unotsaletv anihvka nahskihskini'unhikitv kehsv ahvka nikatv uhv'i nikatv ulhstelhvhtohti uhv'i

ale nikatiy yvwi ketsihskaki kehsehsti ayv tsukwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti khilohskini kvlhskwatihski tikhanhawateki nahski atsihstelhvti kehsehsti

itseyahthahehsti itsiyawhihskehsti ale itsatatolihstihskehsti vlhayenho yitsikahthaha iyu kehsv'i

utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha ilvhitlv hi'a nahski ohstv khanohetv alhihtsitti nikalhstihskehsti elohi nikvnatv'i hi'a nhski tsinatvka nahskwo uninhohet kehsehsti nhski akanvtatihstohti
unathvkanno ohsiyu uniyelvnhe'i ale unithu'ihstanele atelv tsuninhehtiyi uyholenho ohstv utlanvtatehtiyi tsuyohihsehtyi
tunvhsenho anitha'li kvwhahstawatitohi ale hi'a nihtuwehsele'i tikatuhv ihstena totatsatlohsinho ahskaya ayhehehsti athelito ama atlihstehsti ehstihstawatehsvha
ilvhitlvnho wayvlhvha hi'a nehstiwehselvha ahskaya kanela titeyohvhski hi'a nikaweha hatlv anetohi uniyvhstiyi nanha khanohiyeki itsulaha okalhstayvhtiyi kvkihstawatitohi

nahskino aninvlha'e'i ale analhstayvhvhske'i tsihsa hi'a nuwehse'i utohiyhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha ahsiyvwi hi'a tsinitsatvnhv itsulaha tsohstalihstayvhvhska tvkwatluthani

ale ulihskwiti ukihsv ale ulihelitsv nahski tunhele'i nikatvnho nahski unatithahe'i
tuninhokihsvnho uninukotse oliwyo otalv wunilohse'i
ahsenho utli ulhinikitv unhetse hi'a nuwehse'i iyunho nahskwo itsulaha tikinyohuhihsti yiki ahse vtla yvkakvytayika nahskiya nahskwo nuniwehse nikatv
kehsemininho tuto'v uniluhtse'i hi'anho nituwehsele kvwahstawatitohi anhi itsinehsti wikatatolihstihskv ikohitv
tuthenvhsenho kwita ale tsimi ale tsani ale ulenvhe utsathi uteyhahthanele'i ale utsathi ehihsti utanvta'te'i
ale hi'a nituwehsele'i akwatanhvhto utsathi uteyhahthaneha ayohuhihsti nahskiya'i anhi itsinehsti ale itsiyawhihskehsti

nituktsvnhihsv itsvyelatitohvki uthvnvtikalaw'ihstiy tekateyohvhskvki ale vlha yihskiniyvhe'i utohiyuhtihskininonv nikvnhv kowhelv'i

tsihsano nukvwiyuhsv atsilvkelhohi tsuwolhv wunathinhvhsthane'i nahskinho tekvwalawi'e nikatv nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale tinilawiki ale tinowhelihski
kwitano ke iyvtv uhstawatihse'i nahski nukvwiyuhsv atsilvkelhohi tikanelv wuyvlhe'i uwolhenho ketsinvhsitahsti aninv'i ale kothv ukanawohske'i
nunikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv'anelhohi ale nikatv tanilawi'v uniyhe uninhelhvhi tsihsa ulutihski nahski unihihstiyi unatlohtsenho

nunikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv'anelhohi utsathe tsutalenhvtv kvwuhihstihske'i

kikakenho kvwhanhuwe'e'i ale alhstulo tsutsayohsti kolhvhthanvhi unihsteyonhv nahski unihstulothane'i
unatehohthannvnho kvwanhuwehse kikake'i ale uwahsv tsunhuwo tekvwhanhuwo'e'i ale wikvwahthinhvhsthane kvwatvtiyi

kvwanenhelenho utithahsti kikake'atithahsti mila ahsuli ahsenho vlha yunekihse'i
nhakwonho tatanhawhstv kvwatvnv uniyahtholhe tsunhuwo'i unahsehsvhe unatolhohihstiyi nahski anihsiyvwiha tsuninehsvhsti kehsv'i

itsulahanho tekekatvne anithali tinatanahsahvhski ahsiyvwi akhathihsititlv hso'inho akhskani ititlv
nahskiya nahskwo nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv anelhohi al tinowhelihski kvwatehohtihskv hi'a nitanatawehsehe'i nvwanatale tahstelihskvki uwahsv vlha yvkvlhstelv
